description:
A protocol callback's InputDemand was the join over the implementations defined
SO FAR (ForwardingWalk::visit_protocol_callback, jobs/keying.rs, reading
ProtocolDispatch current). DefineModule(protocol) publishes ProtocolDispatch
revision 1 with no implementations, so the first answer is a join over an empty
set published as the answer, "none" standing in for "not known yet". When an
implementation lands (ProtocolDispatch #2) the callback, its forwarders, and
every activation keyed on them are revised.
Reduced case: `def main(), do: Enum.all?([1])` revises Enumerable.reduce_while/3,
Enum.reduce_while/3 and Enum.all?/1.

Paper: the callback's own question is "which implementation?", answered from
the receiver's type. What an implementation asks of its inputs is already asked
where it is called: resolve_protocol_call (jobs/semantic.rs) picks it from the
receiver and keys its activation through prepare_function_call with the
implementation's own demand. So:
  InputDemand(callback) = local [Whole, Ignore, ...], no forwards
It reads no other fact, so it is published once and never revised.
(Option A, all Ignore, measures identically, but it claims that dispatch asks
nothing of its receiver, which is false.)

Proposal page: ../fz-afu.11.html (approved 2026-09-27). Programs are
byte-identical on 7 programs. Close criteria: 00420 work starts 2797 -> 2771
(<= 2794) and take_drop_split InputDemand re-key wakes 12 -> 0 (<= 9).

- claim ratchet predicate_search: shifts 6/8 -> 1/2, analyses 552 -> 550, total 1171 -> 1165
- claim ratchet take_drop_split: shifts 37/44 -> 6/10, analyses 906/8 -> 897/7, total 1940 -> 1916

- RAISE (authorized): take_drop_split DeriveCallGraphComponent 122/19 -> 128/25. Enumerable.{List,Range}.reduce/3
  go 2 -> 5 runs each: the call-graph walk meets the List.reduce chain one link per run, which the
  old demand walk had fetched ahead of time. That walk belongs to fz-afu.8.
